createdAt: YYYY-MM-DD (placeholder: fill with the date of the first run that selects this subset)
status: Registered before any run; no Decisions call has been made for this version
purpose: PR-3 before/after: company-requested stage-one/two scoring input without candidate Memory (company_requested_behavior_v1) against the same input with it

parentDataset.captures: The two unchanged 2026-10-23 role captures: capture.json of the frozen v61 run folders in the ignored runs/ directory, passed as --capture-from. Never overwritten.
parentDataset.integrity: Each run records the parent capture sha256 (replay.json captureSha256) and the captured-inputs fingerprint (subset.json capturedInputsFingerprint); before, after and baseline must share the fingerprint
parentDataset.ifFreshCapture: Only if those folders cannot be found: take a new read-only capture with pre-PR-3 code (runner without --capture-from; with --dry-run it saves a capture-only folder and makes no Decisions call). Its capture.json then replaces read-only-roles-v1 as the parent: record that folder name and capture sha256 here before the first scoring run. Same two roles, different population; read-only-roles-v1 stays unchanged.

selection.rule: captured inputs[*].memory is a non-empty list
selection.basis: Candidate Memory as captured, not the current database
selection.excluded: Candidates without captured Memory: old and pr3 requests are byte-identical for them (checked before any call), so they are not re-scored
selection.record: Selected IDs and counts only in the private subset.json of each run

inputForms.old: Captured input as stored: the pre-PR-3 company-requested scoring input, including candidate Memory
inputForms.pr3: Same rows with candidate Memory removed and inputContractVersion company_requested_behavior_v1: what PR-3 load_inputs returns for them; evaluation_text and build_request are the production builders

runnerOptions: --dataset read-only-roles-memory-subset-v1 --only-with-memory --input-form old|pr3 --capture-from <parent run> [--dry-run]; --dry-run runs only the zero-call checks and prints the expected Decisions calls

configuration.promptVersion: Recorded per run in manifest.json; old and pr3 runs must match (company_requested_decisions_v61 at registration)
configuration.referenceDate: Requests carry the run date, so run old and pr3 on the same date (comparison reports sameReferenceDate)

zeroCallChecks.noMemoryRequestsIdentical: Without captured Memory, old and pr3 stage-one/two requests are byte-identical
zeroCallChecks.pr3RemovesOnlyMemory: pr3 requests equal old requests with an empty Memory list, carry no candidate Memory section, and old requests carry the captured Memory
zeroCallChecks.selection: Selected set is non-empty and unique
zeroCallChecks.runtimeInputContract: Runtime contract is absent (pre-PR-3 code) or company_requested_behavior_v1
zeroCallChecks.memoryLinesAlsoInOtherSections: Informational only: Memory lines that also appear verbatim in Brief, Profile or Behavior Context
zeroCallChecks.onFailure: The runner stops before any Decisions call

gold.structural: structural-v1 of the parent (read-only-roles-manifest-v1.json gold), applied to the subset
inputChecks: No candidate Memory section in any pr3 request actually sent; every old request carries it
Each pr3 stage-one request equals the old one without its Memory section (reference date line aside)
Same selected candidate IDs, captured-inputs fingerprint, dataset and prompt version in both runs

noiseBaseline.source: Frozen-folder case: the parent run's stored stage-one results (evaluation.json) against the fresh old re-score of the same capture (--baseline <parent run>); reused stage-two receipts are excluded
noiseBaseline.ifFreshCapture: A capture-only folder has no stored results. Either run old a second time on the same capture and pass the first old run as --baseline (one more run of calls), or report the baseline as not measured.

metrics: Stage-one proceed flips and flips per axis, especially candidatePracticalScreen
Stage-two criterion label changes and mean fit deltas
Failures kept apart from rejections; usage, time and request counts per run
review: Every reviewQueue entry is read with its captured Memory and classified as a Memory-only fact (expected; listed for the owner), noise, or unexplained (treated as a suspected bug)
acceptance: Structural gold and input checks pass, no unexplained change remains, and the owner has reviewed the Memory-only list. No numeric threshold. Report the scope as: only candidates with captured Memory were re-scored; the others have identical requests and were not run.
privacy: Actual IDs, production text, model outputs and the comparison (it names candidates) only in ignored owner-only runs directories; the registry receives de-identified aggregate reports only
limitations: Candidate Memory as of the capture date, not current
No candidate relevance gold; pass rates and flip counts are not accuracy
Stored stage-two receipts are not reused because requests carry the run date
No third-stage presentation, publication or delivery
Read-only capture is not a global database snapshot
